lines.en: The dokkaebi’s voice, ringing out thunderously.
A crowd of low-grade dokkaebis looked down at us from the air, as though watching a house burn. I could see Bihyung among them. When our eyes met, he whistled and pretended to be looking elsewhere.
The dokkaebi at the center of the crowd slowly opened his mouth.
The dokkaebi was addressing all of Seoul.
[Incarnations of Seoul! I’m afraid I have a little unfortunate news to share. Regrettably, thanks to certain people’s bungling, one of the ‘disasters’ has just awakened in Gangdong-gu.]
The smiling dokkaebi’s eyes met mine.
That bastard?

[Ahh, I feel as though I can hear your sighs all the way up here. I can already see some of you trying to leave Gangdong-gu. Haha, everyone. You should hear me out. If you run away now, you’ll certainly regret it later. Because this ‘disaster’ will most definitely be an opportunity for you.]
The dokkaebi continued in a smooth voice.

[Hasn’t it been hard gathering coins all this time? I know all about it. Your livelihoods collapsed overnight, and then strange bastards started taking your coins. People who were your friends until yesterday suddenly started swinging knives at you. You thought at least you wouldn’t have to go to work anymore, but lo and behold, now the stars floating in the sky are telling you, “Hey, shake your ass a little. I’ll give you 100 coins.”]
[A few constellations snicker.]
But the dokkaebi did not laugh.

[I understand just how fucking awful that feels. The despair of thinking, ‘Ah, fuck it. The world’s gone to hell anyway, so I might as well live however I want,’ and working up the courage, only to discover that this world has already divided people into those who will make it and those who won’t. The defeat you must have felt when you realized that the constellation you barely managed to win over by shaking your ass so hard was inferior to the one attached to some bastard who’d been outstanding from the start. Your anger at this unfair world. I know it all too well myself.]
[Some constellations object to the dokkaebi’s speech.]
From the way he spoke, this was no ordinary dokkaebi.
A timid low-grade dokkaebi couldn’t do something like that. They knew their channel would be ruined if they drew even a little backlash from the constellations.
But that applied to small channels. Dokkaebis with large channels had a whole different level of nerve.
They understood the laws of stories.
You couldn’t set a great story in motion by flattering subscribing constellations and catering only to the tastes of a few.
A true storyteller had to engage with the ‘characters,’ rather than the ‘audience.’
I closely observed the dokkaebi as he continued his speech.

[For all of you, I’ve prepared something. An opportunity for those of you who, because you’re unlucky, unfortunate, and haven’t made an effort, are still ‘people who won’t make it’ to become ‘people who will make it’ overnight!]
A single pointed horn protruding from the crown of his head. Between the folds of his pure white cape, a single leg matching that single horn like a pair of bookends.
Wait, could that bastard be······ ‘Dokgak (獨脚)’?
At that moment, an enormous screen appeared in the air. On it was a boy fleeing, bleeding.

[Now, the boy you’re looking at is nothing less than a walking SSS-grade item! You could say there’s nothing to throw away, from his head to his toes. His name is ‘Myung Ilsang.’ A lucky bastard chosen by the Star Stream who’s been to another world and back. You’ve all imagined it at least once, haven’t you? Being suddenly summoned to another dimension, gaining immense power, spending passionate nights with a cute elf girlfriend, and being hailed as a hero after saving the world! That’s right. This damned bastard is the very ‘disaster’ you’ll be hunting today.]
I’d thought something was strange.
I’d wondered how low-grade dokkaebis could fill the intermediate dokkaebi’s vacant position, but with a dokkaebi from a major channel like that, it was possible.

[I can already hear your complaints. How are you supposed to catch someone wrapped from head to toe in SSS-grade equipment? Haha, please don’t worry. He’s currently under a penalty. His power is sealed. He’s strong, but he’s a treasure vault you can bring down if you all beat him up together.]
“······That fucker gives me the creeps.”
Han Sooyoung clicked her tongue.
As a writer, she seemed to have already grasped the dokkaebi’s intent.
If you called a ‘disaster’ a ‘disaster,’ nobody would come.
But what if you passed that disaster off as a ‘treasure vault’?

[Your lives aren’t ruined yet. In fact, you could say you’re very lucky. The ‘sub-scenario’ I’m about to offer will be an excellent stepping stone to turning your lives around. Now, this opportunity is available for today only! Get moving right now! Only those who move faster than everyone else can become the owners of ‘SSS-grade items’!]
Soon, incarnations scattered throughout Seoul would hear that voice and flock to Gangdong-gu.
[The sub-scenario has been updated.]
<Sub-Scenario ― SSS-Grade Hunt>
Category: Sub
Difficulty: B ~ ???
Clear Conditions: Eliminate the SSS-grade hero ‘Myung Ilsang.’
Time Limit: None
Reward: 50000 coins, ???
Failure: Destruction of the Seoul Dome
The worst possible scenario had finally begun.
Perhaps because of the consequence of ‘Failure’ glowing red in the air, the unprecedented, enormous rewards looked paltry.
“We have to find him fast. Before everyone dies.”
“······That bastard can do this without any probability problems?”
“The moment a large number of constellations decide something looks entertaining, the probability burden gets offset to some extent.”
That was why dokkaebis preferred sensational scenarios.
For stories that many constellations wanted, the constellations themselves shouldered the probability.
Of course, if it failed, the dokkaebi would bear the entire storm, but this situation was different.
[A considerable number of constellations’ eyes sparkle.]
If things went as Dokgak intended, Seoul would be finished before the fifth scenario even began. Han Sooyoung immediately summoned avatars with all her magic power. Then, perhaps five minutes later.
“Found him. Two kilometers northwest of here!”
I ran down the road with Han Sooyoung’s original body. Soon, I heard a murmur of voices.
“There! He’s over there!”
“That bastard’s the one who went to another world!”
People had already gathered. Surrounded by the crowd that had surged toward him, Myung Ilsang was smiling cheerfully.
“Uh······ that’s right. That’s me.”
“You smug bastard! Had some fun over there, did you?”
“I had all sorts of fun······.”
“I’m so fucking jealous of that bastard······ Hey! Everyone, kill him!”
It struck me anew how many people were steeped in feelings of inferiority.
Dodging several blades swinging through the air, Myung Ilsang asked,
“If you’re that jealous, should I send you there too?”
“What? We can go too?”
“Of course. You certainly can. You really want to go, right?”
“Of course we’d want to, if we could! Compared to this fucking world······.”
Myung Ilsang nodded and extended his right arm toward the crowd.
[The eighth seal of returnee ‘Myung Ilsang’ is released.]
[The ninth seal of returnee ‘Myung Ilsang’ is released.]
“Then have a nice trip. Though I don’t know if it’ll be any better than here.”
“What?”
[The twelfth seal of returnee ‘Myung Ilsang’ is released.]
[The thirteenth seal of returnee ‘Myung Ilsang’ is released.]
[The fourteenth seal of returnee ‘Myung Ilsang’ is released.]
A faint despair came over me as I watched the messages rise high into the air.
It was already too late.
“Because I destroyed that place.”
[Returnee ‘Myung Ilsang’ activates ‘Medium Black Flame Cannon (中黑炎砲) Lv.3’!]
I snatched up Han Sooyoung and flung myself behind a building.

A violet flash overturned the forest of buildings. Five or six high-rises were half demolished, and an entire street vanished. The people running toward him disintegrated without leaving so much as powdered bone.
A being who could become a ‘disaster’ all on his own.
That was the true power of a ‘returnee.’
Beside me, Han Sooyoung sank limply to the ground.
“That’s insane······ How do we beat that?”
This was true fear. Fear that made your body tremble all on its own, without any mind-affecting skill at work. I spoke as though resisting it.
“We can win.”
“Cut the bullshit and let’s go back. There’s no way we can take him down.”
“No. I’m telling you, we can. If we take him down now, the rewards will be better too.”
[Character ‘Han Sooyoung’ activates ‘Lie Detection Lv.2.’]
[Han Sooyoung has confirmed that the statement is true.]
Han Sooyoung’s eyes widened.
“······Seriously? Earlier, you acted like there was no way we could take him down.”
“How’s anyone supposed to live with only one idea in their head?”
My words were only half true.
In fact, my original plan had been to defeat the strengthened ‘Disaster of Questions’ and build my second Story.
The problem was that my plan assumed I’d learned [Way of the Wind].
“Anyone else want to go to another world? Raise your hand! I’ll send you!”
People fled, screaming.
Myung Ilsang’s presence was drawing closer.
A translucent window appeared, and Yoo Joonghyuk’s voice came through.
―There’s no chance of winning in a head-on fight.
―I know. I still have to try.
―Why did you bring things this far?
―What?
―You had several opportunities. If you’d killed Lee Seolhwa. Or joined forces with Lycaon and killed Antinus, you could have stopped the disaster.
I could have made excuses if I wanted.
I hadn’t killed Lee Seolhwa because of Yoo Joonghyuk, and I hadn’t joined forces with Lycaon because I couldn’t find an opening to intervene.
―I’m not a regressor like you. If I fail, it’s over, so I have to be careful. If I don’t think everything through, again and again······.
―Careful? Don’t be arrogant. Do you think you’re a constellation? Knowing a little about the future doesn’t mean you can control everything.
It felt as though someone had struck me hard in the solar plexus.
Absurdly enough, it was because I thought Yoo Joonghyuk was partly right.
[Exclusive skill ‘Fourth Wall’ is active.]
The arrogance of knowing the original story. The belief that even if the story went awry, I could somehow find a way.
Perhaps that was what had brought things this far.
―Then why don’t you fight, if you’re so great? Instead of trusting a hopeless case like me.
―Don’t use talent as an excuse. [Way of the Wind] isn’t the only way to win.
―I need it to win, you know?
Yoo Joonghyuk was silent for a moment. Just as I was about to respond to that silence, which seemed to say I was pathetic, his voice continued.
―My attribute is ‘Pro Gamer.’ What’s yours?
―What?
―I asked what you’re good at.
······What I was good at?
It felt as though some corner deep in my unconscious was itching. The feeling that I was missing something important. But there was no time to think.
“Found you! Someone who hasn’t gone yet.”
Myung Ilsang’s face popped out from around the corner like something in a horror movie.
Han Sooyoung let out a groan, and I took a step back.
“······Huh? You’re those Hunter Association people from earlier, aren’t you?”
Myung Ilsang approached with a smile.
“Perfect. I was just hoping to see you. Do you know you ruined my grand debut plans?”

“I was going to live a good life. Kill a few S-grade incarnations who throw their weight around, crush some evil groups, give pretty noonas some love. But what’s this? Now I’m a full-blown villain. What are you going to do about it?”
Instead of answering, I tightened my grip on my sword.
[Stigma ‘Song of the Sword Lv.1’ has been activated!]
[Your sword is imbued with a passage left by the Duke of Loyalty and Warfare.]
「Today, this humble subject is truly prepared to die. I beseech Heaven: grant that I may annihilate the enemy without fail.」
The Duke of Loyalty and Warfare’s words, recorded in the Collected Works of Baeksa.
Fortunately, the Duke of Loyalty and Warfare took my side this time.
[Stigma ‘Song of the Sword’ takes effect!]
[Your resolve in the face of death enhances your combat power.]
I squeezed out all my magic power at once.
[‘Blade of Faith’ is activated!]
The Blade of Faith, swollen as though it would burst.
I charged toward him.
Claaang!

Myung Ilsang’s hand casually knocked aside the ‘Blade of Faith.’ Pain shot through my hand as though it would snap. We had exchanged only one blow, but I could tell clearly. Myung Ilsang’s overall stats were already far beyond the scenario’s limits.
“What, you want to fight? Seriously? Didn’t you just see me fight?”
Watching him smile, I clenched my teeth and called to mind the pages of ‘Ways of Survival.’
What I was good at.
It was ‘reading.’
[Stage 1 of exclusive skill ‘Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint’ is activated!]
And I began to hear his movements.
「Right shoulder」
Fwoosh!
「Left thigh」
Craack!
Blows I couldn’t block or dodge even after reading them came flying at me. His fists, wreathed in violet energy, rained down mercilessly.
「Stomach, stomach, stomach, stomach, stomach, stomach.」
Blood burst from my mouth, and my vision wavered for a moment.
But I didn’t give up.
I thought, and thought again.
[Character ‘Myung Ilsang’ admires your tenacity.]
[Your understanding of character ‘Myung Ilsang’ has increased.]
I couldn’t beat him with only the information in ‘Ways of Survival.’ This was different from hunting the [Dark Keeper]. I couldn’t calculate everything before fighting.
「Strongweakmediumweakstrongweakmediumweak」

As too much information flooded in at once alongside the barrage of blows, my dizziness gradually worsened. It was this bad even with the stigma’s power. At this rate, the fight would be decided in an instant.
Wiping the blood from my mouth, I leaped back.
······Would I have to use [Ganpyeongui] after all?

It left a bitter taste that my last resort was borrowing a constellation’s power. If I received the protection of a powerful Historical-grade constellation, or the Constellations of the Big Dipper, I could probably win.
But there was the probability burden after the last incident, and above all, I didn’t like owing the constellations.
Damn it, how great would it be if I had talent too?
I felt like I’d rather steal someone else’s talent, if I could.
······Huh? Wait. Steal?
A dull shock swept through my mind.
Until now, my main weapon had been ‘information.’
But with so much ‘information,’ I’d forgotten the information I actually needed.
Pathetic. Why on earth had I forgotten that skill?
Shouldn’t that have been the very first thing I tried?
[Exclusive skill ‘Bookmark’ is activated.]
[‘Character Bookmark’ is activated.]
[Available bookmark slots: 4]
[Loading the list of bookmarks available for activation.]
<List of Characters Registered in Bookmarks>
1. Delusion Demon Kim Namwoon (Understanding 35)
2. Steel Sword Emperor Lee Hyunsung (Understanding 75)
3. Inciter Cheon Inho (Understanding 20)
4. Empty Slot
Apart from one additional slot, nothing seemed to have changed.
I selected the empty slot.
<List of Characters Currently Available for Bookmark Registration>
1. Poison Beauty Lee Seolhwa (Understanding 10)
2. King of Beauty Min Jiwon (Understanding 25)
3. Tyrant King Jung Youngho (Understanding 10)
4. Reclusive Loner Han Donghoon (Understanding 30)
5. Prophet Anna Croft (Understanding 1)
6. Armed Fortress Master Gong Pildu (Understanding 30)
As expected, Yoo Joonghyuk’s name wasn’t on the list.
Still, he was the protagonist, so perhaps he would only become available once special conditions were met.
Others who weren’t ‘characters,’ such as Han Sooyoung, Yoo Sangah, and Lee Gilyoung, didn’t appear on the list either.
It didn’t matter. They weren’t the ones I needed right now anyway.
After scrolling for a while, I finally found the character I wanted.
There he was, just as I’d thought.
Why had I forgotten that he was a ‘character’ too?
Without hesitation, I placed that character in bookmark slot 4.
[Activation duration is determined in proportion to the level of the Bookmark skill.]
[Activation Duration: 30 minutes]
[Your understanding of the character is considerable. You may select and copy some of this character’s skills.]
I selected a skill.
And the next moment, a silver storm swept through my body.
I felt the majestic courage of a wolf settle within me.
Damn it, I’d been an idiot.
Why had I been trying to learn this all this time?
I was neither a regressor nor a returnee.
[Character ‘Lycaon, Prince of the Imyuntar’ has been registered in bookmark slot 4.]
[Bookmark slot 4 has been activated.]
I was a reader.
[「Way of the Wind Lv.8」 has been activated.]
And this was how I fought.
Whooooooosh!
Feeling the refreshing wind wrap around my entire body, I reflected anew on the sentences from ‘Ways of Survival.’ Summoning avatars beside me, Han Sooyoung realized which skill I was about to use.
“What? You said you couldn’t learn that!”
“Stay back.”
[Way of the Wind].
「A gale in the left hand, a storm in the right. Where the straight line and the curve collide, the Way of the Wind shall open.」
That sentence, which I had never understood at all, became reality the moment I felt the wind curling around my toes.
Myung Ilsang’s fist suddenly closed in and brushed the tip of my nose.
An attack that should surely have hit me came to nothing. The power of a skill that bridged an overwhelming gap in stats. This was the Imyuntar’s secret technique.
An unusual gleam appeared in Myung Ilsang’s eyes.
“······Huh? You got faster?”
I didn’t answer, focusing on what I’d realized. From now on, it was a race against time.
Thirty minutes remained on Bookmark.
“Aha, I get it. That’s those wolf bastards’ skill, isn’t it?”
Myung Ilsang looked at me with mockery in his expression.
“You’re just using some trashy skill, and you act like you’ve had some great revelation?”
“You know what? I killed their king with this very hand.”
Of course you did.
I thought of the creatures of Chronos who had died on a strange planet.
Lycaon, Prince of the Imyuntar; Antinus, Queen of the Parasites······.
The fate of creatures who stubbornly survived even after their home disappeared, only to be used as material for scenarios unfolding on another planet.
If Earth were destroyed like this, its people would end up in the same position.
Booooom!
The Medium Black Flame Cannon fired from Myung Ilsang’s right hand.
「One wind meets another to form taeguk, and again, one wind meets another to form yin and yang.」
I used every bit of my imagination to conjure the concrete image contained in that passage.
Hot and cold energies gathered and swirled before my eyes, and soon the wind’s direction began to twist.
Crackle-crackle!
The Black Flame Cannon’s ether, its course deflected ever so slightly, collided with itself, scattering its energy in every direction.
All ether attacks propagated through a medium. Disrupt the basis of that propagation, and the attack had no choice but to come to nothing.
Myung Ilsang looked a little surprised.
“······Not bad. So you can pull off a trick like that?”
Biting his lip hard, Myung Ilsang began to flee again.
[Character ‘Myung Ilsang’ uses ‘Blink Lv.4’!]
Blink again? But chasing him was no longer difficult. Simply by closing my eyes and concentrating on the wind, I could read every presence nearby.

I raced down the road at a speed that left me with no reason to envy Yoo Joonghyuk’s [Red Phoenix Shunpo], and found Myung Ilsang. He was grabbing people at random and continuing to ask questions. I sent him flying with a blow straight to the back.
Thwaaack!
Struck by my kick, Myung Ilsang flew through a building’s steel frame. Despite a blow that should have shattered his bones, he got up unharmed.
[The twenty-fourth seal of returnee ‘Myung Ilsang’ is released.]
His next seal had been released a split second before.
“······That tickles.”
An attitude that suggested he was playing a game.
He probably believed he would win in the end anyway.
With each seal released, his wounds healed, while my magic power consumption kept rising as time passed.
“Hahaha, go on, try blocking it again!”
In fact, I could never kill him by using [Way of the Wind] only as a buff skill.
If that alone could defeat the [Disaster of Questions], Chronos would never have been destroyed in the first place.
I’d have to do ‘that’ after all.
The problem was······ someone would have to buy me time to use this technique.
I saw something suddenly fall at an angle from the sky on the opposite side.
Appearing like a diving falcon, the black figure pierced the blue sky and plunged straight toward Myung Ilsang.
KABOOOOOM!
A small crater formed with a terrible blast.
Above Myung Ilsang, who had been crushed into the ground, stood the familiar figure of a man.
Staring at the man with my mouth half open, I muttered,
“······Yoo Joonghyuk?”
Hadn’t this bastard said it would take him two days to recover?
Watching Yoo Joonghyuk stride toward me, I instinctively took a couple of steps back.
Surely he hadn’t come to beat me up in the middle of all this?
But Yoo Joonghyuk stopped a couple of paces in front of me, then turned his back.
“Begin.”
Yoo Joonghyuk stood with his back to me, as though he knew what I was about to do.
“I’ll hold him off.”
Han Sooyoung, sprawled nearby, muttered on my behalf.
“Ha, fuck. That’s the protagonist for you······.”
But despite his confident voice, Yoo Joonghyuk looked vulnerable.
A body that still hadn’t recovered.
Dark veins bulged all over him.
Myung Ilsang had already climbed out of the crater. Grinning, he spat out blood.
“Ah, this is getting a little annoying······.”
Even after taking that attack, he still seemed hardly hurt. It was almost impossible to believe he was among the weaker ‘returnees’ who would appear in the future.
Myung Ilsang charged, and Yoo Joonghyuk ran to meet him.
And I activated [Way of the Wind].
「Four winds meet to form the cardinal directions, and four more winds join them to achieve the mysteries of the Eight Trigrams. Thus, the wind exists everywhere, and nowhere.」
Now it was my turn to use the passage through which Lycaon had gained enlightenment.
Crrrrrack!
A wondrous wall of air, following the form of the Eight Trigrams, began to swirl around us and enclose the area.
A small, dome-shaped space. Its airtight enclosure made my breath catch.
From now on, it was a race against time. Yoo Joonghyuk was struck and flung backward, and Myung Ilsang’s expression hardened.
At last, he too had realized this wasn’t a game.
“What are you plotting······!”
The next moment, I expelled all the air from the dome.
Whoooooosh!
My ears suddenly felt blocked, and sound disappeared.
The wind raged fiercely, but inside the dome it was as quiet as the eye of a storm.
Myung Ilsang opened his mouth.
He moved his mouth again and again, but I couldn’t hear his voice.
Without a medium, sound could not travel.
He was in a perfect vacuum.
Fsssssh.
The pressure difference instantly drew the air out of my lungs. I quickly pulled it back in.
Outside the dome, Han Sooyoung was shouting something.
[Stage 2 of exclusive skill ‘Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint’ activates!]
「What is this?」
I began to hear Myung Ilsang’s inner thoughts.
「Why won’t my voice come out? Is it magic?」
Myung Ilsang was shouting in confusion.
Understandably so.
All returnees had penalties. This was especially true of returnees who could quickly regain their original power under specific conditions.
[The ‘Disaster of Questions’ penalty is activated.]
[The power of returnee ‘Myung Ilsang’ weakens.]
[The twenty-fourth seal of returnee ‘Myung Ilsang’ is restored.]
「Aaaah, no!」
Just as they could easily grow stronger, they also had conditions under which they could ‘weaken easily.’
[The twenty-third seal of returnee ‘Myung Ilsang’ is restored.]
Why did the [Disaster of Questions] keep asking ‘questions’?
It was simple.
Because the longer he went without asking a question someone could hear, the weaker his stats became.
「Fuck! Let me out! Let me out right now!」
His fists struck the wall of air again and again, but it didn’t break easily. In a space without a medium, even the Black Flame Cannon’s flames could not burn.
[The twenty-second seal of returnee ‘Myung Ilsang’ is restored.]
The Vacuum Prison (眞空監獄) that could be created using [Way of the Wind]. This was the best method I knew for defeating the [Disaster of Questions].
「Aaaaaah!」
Myung Ilsang belatedly lunged at me. He seemed to think the [Vacuum Prison] would break if I died, but that wasn’t going to happen. I had created this place.
Using [Way of the Wind] to dodge his attacks, I rapidly reduced the prison’s area.
Rrrrrumble!
As the walls contracted, I created a narrow passage and escaped the dome with Yoo Joonghyuk.
Now Myung Ilsang was the only one left inside.
「······You bastards!」

He wasn’t a returnee for nothing. His attacks at full strength gradually cracked the dome. When I raised my hand, the winds crossed and filled the weakened areas. Then the dome began to shrink rapidly.
Trickle.
My nose bled from the strain of intense concentration.
My ultimate goal was to confine that ‘Vacuum Prison’ to his body alone.
But controlling it wasn’t easy.
Damn it, Yoo Joonghyuk made it look easy. Why was this so hard?
“Don’t try to force it under your control. You must guide the wind.”
Yoo Joonghyuk’s voice.
At that moment, a realization flashed through me.
Perhaps I’d only imagined that I had to create a ‘wall.’ What mattered was removing the medium around his body.
Whoooooosh!
「U-ugh, uuuugh, aaaaah! I can’t breathe!」
Myung Ilsang clawed at his throat, writhing as bloody tears streamed from his eyes.
“······Not bad. You aren’t entirely without talent.”
Yoo Joonghyuk’s voice reached me again.
And Myung Ilsang began his final desperate struggle.
[Character ‘Myung Ilsang’ uses ‘Large Black Flame Cannon Lv.3’!]
Myung Ilsang’s right arm was engulfed in pitch-black flames.
Booooooom!
Amazingly, the Large Black Flame Cannon burst through the dome of wind.
Shielding Yoo Joonghyuk’s body, I threw myself flat. A dull impact scraped past overhead. As though he intended to squeeze out every last bit of magic power, his Large Black Flame Cannon kept firing.
But wind was wind for a reason.
Once the Large Black Flame Cannon passed through, the wind instantly filled the space again.
However desperately he struggled, nothing would change.
The problem was that people were dying from the black flames scattering like sparks.
Seeing my expression, Yoo Joonghyuk said,
“Kim Dokja, don’t get any foolish ideas. It doesn’t matter if those bastards die.”
“I’m sure some of them are like that.”
But not everyone was.
I rose to my feet and confronted the Large Black Flame Cannon with all my strength.
The torrent of black flames scattered and twisted under the force of the powerfully rotating dome. Then terrible pain followed. The black flames I couldn’t block completely had poured onto me.
The black flames burned my skin, and sensation gradually faded from my joints.
I could do this.
He wasn’t strong right now.
At that moment, I had passed beyond my limits and reached another realm.
As my senses grew faint, it felt as though my body had become the wind itself.
[A constellation that likes effort enjoys your pain.]
[A trace of talent sleeping in your soul blossoms.]

With my left hand, I controlled the [Vacuum Prison], while with my right I moved the wind to disperse the Large Black Flame Cannon’s energy. In a state of complete absorption, I was tasting a new realm of [Way of the Wind].
The wind playing at my fingertips was sketching a landscape I had never known.
[Exclusive skill ‘Fourth Wall’ temporarily becomes thinner.]
So this was what it felt like.
This was the world the [characters] saw.

A sensation I could never have known, however diligently I read and pondered the text. It felt as though I fully understood a part of the narrative I had only felt through the pages at my fingertips, yet could never reach.
Reading something and understanding it were different.
Perhaps I still didn’t properly understand even one percent of this world.
At last, I felt Myung Ilsang’s Black Flame Cannon weaken.
「Fuck! You sons of bitches! Die! Diiiie!」
The rapidly diminishing force of the Black Flame Cannon.
And I was still brimming with magic power.
Something was strange.
However completely absorbed I’d become, there was no way I should have this much magic power, was there?
Behind me, Yoo Joonghyuk spoke through gritted teeth.
“······Because I’m the one who’s going to kill you.”
······I’d wondered why my back felt warm. So it was Yoo Joonghyuk’s magic power.
And a short while later, Myung Ilsang’s attacks stopped.
[All seals of returnee ‘Myung Ilsang’ have been restored.]
Yoo Joonghyuk and I looked at each other.
[Exclusive skill ‘Way of the Wind Lv.8’ is deactivated.]
Terrified, Myung Ilsang was looking at us with his hands clutching his throat.
“K-kugh, khuhugh······!”
As he frantically gulped air and tried to flee, I threw [Unbreakable Faith] at him.
“Khuuugh!”
